data.one_liner: A Flutter SDK that bundles fast networking, secure API handling, and reusable Material UI widgets.
data.what_it_does: It provides a high‑performance networking API with robust error handling, a set of customizable Material components such as a multi‑select dropdown, and theming utilities. The SDK aims to accelerate development while keeping security and scalability in mind.
use_when: You need a single package that covers networking, UI components, and theming for a Flutter app
You want enterprise‑grade security and error handling out of the box
You prefer a declarative widget style for UI elements
avoid_when: You only need lightweight networking and plan to use a dedicated HTTP client like dio
You already have a comprehensive UI kit and only need networking
You are targeting a very small app with minimal dependencies
strengths: Fast, reliable networking API with structured error responses
Built‑in security features and scalable architecture
Rich set of reusable Material widgets and theming tools
Single dependency for multiple concerns reduces boilerplate
weaknesses: Large bundle size due to many features
Not all features may be needed for simple projects
Documentation is limited to README and changelog, deeper API docs are missing
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec, import package, no build_runner or permissions required

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a mature HTTP client with interceptors and advanced features if you only need networking

alternatives.name: google_fonts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers font theming without the extra UI widgets and networking overhead
